If you play "Casino 7s" often, bookmark this page. The write-up is updated with each morning's data.
2775.headline: How much has sold

2776.body:
"Patriotic Payout" has 342,912 prizes of $2 still unclaimed, which is its most common win. Just below the top prize is the $500 prize, with 104 left. The full count for every prize level is listed below.

Everything here about "Patriotic Payout" comes from official Texas lottery numbers, current through November 11.
2776.headline: What's actually left to win

2779.body:
Of all the tickets printed for "Gnome for the Holidays", most are still unsold. The game is near the start of its run, with 51 of 57 top prizes unclaimed. In every scratcher, either the tickets or the prizes run out first. The rest of this page shows the details.

The numbers for "Gnome for the Holidays" are recalculated every morning, and this page changes with them.
2779.headline: Where this game is in its run

2780.body:
"Holiday Countdown" is new from the Texas Lottery. It is a $5 game with five top prizes of $100,000. Nothing big has been won yet because almost no one has played it. This page will show it when that changes.

Every line of Holiday Countdown's prize table below shows today's count, not last month's.
2780.headline: New game, all prizes left

2781.body:
"The Perfect Gift" just reached Texas stores with five top prizes of $250,000. A new game is the easiest kind to judge. No prizes have been claimed, and the printed odds are accurate for now. Every day of sales changes that, and this page tracks it.

Today's free summary of "The Perfect Gift" ends here. Every number behind it is on this page.
2781.headline: First day on sale

2782.body:
"$1,000,000 Diamond Deluxe" just went on sale in Texas. The game has eight full prize levels with four top prizes of $1 million. Every scratcher starts this way and loses prizes as it sells. You are seeing this one before that starts, when it is easiest to judge.

Tomorrow's count on "$1,000,000 Diamond Deluxe" will be a little different. The game sells every day, and this page keeps track.
2782.headline: New in stores
